review.brief: Review JBH-62 diff 0cb3b19..HEAD in jbh-finance (module code only). User-confirmed design (decision D3): async adjust + product row lock (PESSIMISTIC_WRITE, TxType.MANDATORY) as FIRST statement of every balance-writing transaction; in-JVM lock rejected; @Version rejected; QuarkusUnitOfWork now rethrows and rolls back on any Exception. Check: (1) every flow in design.md D3 table locks first inside one transaction, incl. background adjust task, register (two transactions, D7) and upload (D9); (2) no in-JVM state is used for correctness (project 'Horizontal scaling' rule); the single-thread executor (D2) is ordering-only; (3) no transaction waits for a background task (D6); awaitPendingSync runs outside transactions; (4) no Thread.sleep left in src/main or tests except AsyncTaskExecutorImplTest; existing test assertions unchanged; (5) Test contract in design.md: new test classes exist and check the stated expected values; accepted deviations (decision D6): shared fake RecordingUnitOfWork, Mockito ProductLifecycleService in ProcessMonthlyBalanceServiceImplTest. No DB migration (D10, unique constraint already exists). Signals: build + module suite (319 tests) and 5 repeat runs were run by the leader (assistantRunsTests), all green; task 7.4 (manual 2-instance check) is user-pending and optional. Judge test quality by reading the tests. Performance-Profile: none. ROUND 3 (scope extended by the user, decisions D8, D10): review only 4f79634..3842268 - task 7.5 opt-in DB lock test in jbh-finance-infra (pom, test profile, init SQL, test class) and the jbh-finance/AGENTS.md. findings.note: jbh-finance-infra ProductUseCasesCDIConfig.java:113, 157, 225 (producer at :125-127): processMonthlyBalanceService() is a producer called as a plain method from other producers. Each call builds a new ProcessMonthlyBalanceServiceImpl with its own new AsyncTaskExecutorImpl(). So the PMBS that RegisterMonthlyBalanceInputPort gets (:225) is not the one inside accountMovementServiceApplication() (:113) that receives the initial movement's adjust task. awaitPendingSync() then waits on an idle executor and returns at once, so tx2 can write the report before the adjust (the ordering D7 replaces the 2 s sleep for). The row lock still protects data, but the order guarantee (D2, D6, D7) is lost in production. design.md D8 claim 'one @ApplicationScoped bean, so one executor' is not true for this wiring (unit tests use one shared instance, so they cannot see it). Fix: one shared instance for all uses (e.g. @Inject ProcessMonthlyBalanceService field, or a single field), and the same for ProcessMovementService used by register. If the leader proves ArC returns the one bean here, record the proof in design.md and close this.
